title: Heat Input Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for heat input dQ must correctly relate dQ to dM and dB.

title: Entropy Differential
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the differential of entropy dS must accurately reflect its dependence on dM and dB.

title: Entropy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The derived expression for entropy S must be complete and correctly formulated.

title: Correct Use of Variables
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly apply the variables M, B, and T in the context of thermodynamic relationships.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid common sign mistakes in the expressions for dQ and dS.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response should check that all terms have consistent units throughout the derivations.
